summary: DeepSeek released an experimental multimodal model, V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, on its API platform along with a Files API and an updated agent harness.

mechanisms.reason: The document claims a major leap in multimodal agent benchmark performance over the prior model, approaching a rival frontier model.
mechanisms.quote: On multimodal agent benchmarks, V4-Flash-Vision-Exp makes a major leap over V4-Flash, bringing multimodal agent performance close to Opus-4.8.

mechanisms.reason: The model is explicitly positioned to expand agent tool-use workflows by combining vision with tool calling across agent frameworks.
mechanisms.quote: V4-Flash-Vision-Exp works smoothly across agent frameworks, combining visual understanding with a wide range of tools to unlock more practical workflows.
